exercises.instruction: Complete the sentences. Use a preposition + whom or which. Choose a preposition from:

parts: Fortunately we had a good map,
two people were injured, happened late last night.
I share an office with my boss,
only family members were invited, was a lovely occasion.
Ben showed me his new car,
Sarah showed us a picture of her son,
Laura bought a very nice leather bag,
we went for a long walk.

exercises.instruction: Use the information in the first sentence to complete the second one. Use all of / most of etc.

parts: We were given a lot of information,
Ten people applied for the job,

answers: one of which they never use
half of which he gave to his parents
neither of whom she replied to

parts: There were a lot of people at the party,
answers: only a few of whom I knew

parts: We stayed at a very nice hotel,
answers: the name of which I don't remember

parts: We drove along the road, the
answers: sides of which were lined with trees

parts: The company has a new business plan,
answers: the aim of which is to save money

exercises.instruction: Complete the sentences. Choose from the box and use which.
wordBank: This makes it hard to contact her.
This means we can’t go away tomorrow.
This makes it difficult to sleep sometimes.
This was very kind of her.
This meant I had to wait two hours at the airport.

parts: Laura couldn’t come to the party,
The street I live in is noisy at night,
answers: which makes it difficult to sleep sometimes

parts: Kate let me stay at her house,
answers: which was very kind of her
which makes it hard to contact her
which meant I had to wait two hours at the airport
which means we can’t go away tomorrow
